post.description:
Register a new user account.

Raises 409 if the email or username is already taken. When
``HIDE_REGISTRATION_EXISTENCE`` is enabled (with the email-verification
flow, later ticket), duplicates get a generic 201 instead so the
endpoint cannot be used to enumerate accounts.

Authenticate a user and set the httpOnly cookie pair.

Guarded twice: per-IP window (production) and per-account lockout
(5 consecutive failures → 10 min). Failure messages never distinguish
"no such email" from "wrong password".

get.description: Return the currently authenticated user's profile.

post.description:
Rotate the refresh cookie and mint a fresh access token.

Strictly cookie-based: the old refresh token is revoked (single use),
so a stolen refresh token dies on first legitimate rotation. Legacy
Bearer-only clients get 401 and simply log in again.

Log out: revoke the presented refresh token and clear cookies.

The access cookie dies here and now; any other tab holds at most a
15-minute access token, after which the revoked refresh cannot renew.

Run an EDA action on the session's dataset.

Request body: ``{"action": "describe"|"corr"|"plot"|"scatter"|"regression"|"missing"}``.
- ``describe`` → ``{columns, rows}`` per-variable stats table.
- ``corr``     → ``{variables, matrix}`` Pearson correlation matrix.
- ``missing``  → ``{columns, rows}`` missing-value report.
- ``plot`` / ``scatter`` / ``regression`` → placeholder (later tickets).

Stage D：返回 ``EdaResponse``（``action`` + ``result``，``result`` 承载
各 action 的具体 shape；``EdaResponse`` 用 ``extra="allow"`` 保留
describe / corr / missing 的原始字段）。
Accept a CSV / Stata (.dta) / Excel (.xlsx) upload, parse meta, run the graph.

get.description: Return all sessions owned by the current user.

post.description:
Create an empty session (no upload).

If the user is authenticated, the session is owned by that user.

get.description:
Return session existence and basic info.

Used by the frontend to verify a saved sessionId is still valid
after a page refresh (localStorage recovery flow).

delete.description: Delete a session owned by the current user.

schema.title: Response Delete Session Sessions  Session Id  Delete

schema.title: Response Get Degradation Sessions  Session Id  Degradation Get

get.description:
Export a session's paper in the requested format.

When S3 is configured, the export file is uploaded to S3 and the response
redirects to a presigned download URL.  Without S3, returns the content
inline as ``PlainTextResponse`` (Stage D 文件下载端点豁免）。

post.description: 接受研究方向 → set_direction → 识别验真 → 非 0 星再生成 outline。
接受用户调整后的 outline → 写入 user_adjusted_outline → 重跑 generate_outline。
Build the formal short draft on an atomic Facade state copy.

get.description: Read the claim evidence directly from the canonical Facade state.

post.description:
用户审批章节 → 标记 status="approved"。

graph resume 由后续集成阶段在 graph 层加 interrupt() 后实现；此处只
更新 session 状态。

回滚到指定版本。

Request:  ``{"chapter_index": int, "version_index": int}``
Response: ``{"chapter": {...}, "body_chapters": [...]}``

把 chapter_index / version_index 写入 state 后调
``rollback_chapter(state)`` 节点（T-08a），节点返回
``{"body_chapters": [...]}``，合并回 session 状态。

重新生成当前章。

Request:  ``{"chapter_index": int, "instruction"?: str}``
Response: ``{"chapter": {...含新版本...}, "body_chapters": [...]}``

设置 ``state['current_chapter_index']``，可选把 ``instruction`` 写入
``revision_suggestions[index]``，再调 ``generate_chapter(state)``。
空 instruction 仍重生成。

按用户指令改写当前章，或把用户 markdown 落盘。

Request:  ``{"chapter_index": int, "instruction": str?}``
          或 ``{"chapter_index": int, "content": str?}``
Response: ``{"chapter": {...}, "body_chapters": [...]}``

``instruction`` 写入 ``revision_suggestions`` 后走
``generate_chapter``（与 regenerate 同一条写管线）。
``content`` 直接 prepend 新版本，``status="edited"``。

get.description:
获取指定章节的所有版本。

Response: ``{"chapter_index": int, "count": int,
              "versions": [{"index": int, "preview": str}]}``

每个版本的 ``preview`` 截断到前 50 字。章节无 ``versions`` 列表时，
降级用 ``content`` 作为唯一版本。

post.description:
设计对话：把念头聊成研究设定卡（dv/iv/controls/method 逐轮抽齐）。

与 /desk/discuss 同属会话前的对话阶段，不要求登录（不触任何用户数据）。

schema.title: Response Transcribe Desk Desk Transcribe Post

post.description:
Apply variable recoding & construction (sub-step 5).

Request body (flat form, matching the frontend VariableConstructor):
``{"type": "log_transform"|"onehot"|"label"|"bin"|"interaction"|"policy_dummy",
   "column": str, ...}``

The flat ``type``/``column`` is translated into the nested config that
``cleaning.transform.transform`` expects.

Apply sample filtering (sub-step 6).

Request body: ``{"conditions": [{"col": str, "op": str, "val": Any}, ...]}``

Check panel balance (sub-step 7).

Request body: ``{"panel_id": str, "time_col": str}``

Stage D 修复漂移 1：返回 ``BalanceResponse``（4 字段：
``balanced`` / ``unbalanced`` / ``n_periods`` / ``attrition_rate``），
不再直接透传 step report。``unbalanced`` 在 router 层补算
（总 panel 数 - balanced 数），因为 BalanceStep 的 step report 不含
``unbalanced`` 字段（只有 ``balanced`` / ``n_periods`` /
``attrition_rate``）。

get.description:
Run the profiling dataset-type detector on the session CSV.

Returns ``{dataset_type, charls_config?}``. ``charls_config`` is the
parsed ``charls.yaml`` and is only included when the dataset is
detected as CHARLS.

post.description:
Persist the user-confirmed CHARLS wizard config into session state.

The wizard payload is written to ``state["charls_config"]`` so
downstream nodes (clean_data sub-steps, eda, outline) can read
readable variable names instead of raw CHARLS codes.
Run translate_code so GET /code-export can return Stata / R files.

get.description:
导出代码文件。

Parameters
----------
session_id : str
    会话 ID。
format : str
    代码格式：``py`` / ``do`` / ``R`` / ``m``。默认 ``py``。

Returns
-------
PlainTextResponse
    带 ``Content-Disposition: attachment; filename="..."`` 的代码文本。

Raises
------
HTTPException
    - 404: session 不存在，或 no takeable translation (empty stubs are not files)
    - 400: 不支持的 format
导出文档：format=tex|pdf|docx，template=4 模板之一。

返回 8 阶段研究旅程进度（收敛版，去掉了无节点的"表格图形"站）。

每个阶段状态：``pending`` / ``active`` / ``completed`` / ``interrupt``。
currentStage 为正在进行的阶段；若 state 为空，降级为第 0 站 active、
其余 pending，不抛错。

返回当前章的评审信息。

Response: ``{chapter_index, feedback, suggestions, score, rubric,
             review_iteration, max_review_iterations, auto_decision,
             review_source, review_degraded, grounding_failures}``

无评审数据时返回 200 + 空字段（非 404），让前端渲染空态。

post.description:
接收人工评审决策，写入 state。

Request:  ``{decision: "accept"|"reject"|"force_pass", reviewer?, comment?}``
Response: ``{ok, decision, chapter_index, next_action}``

- ``accept`` / ``force_pass`` → ``next_action="proceed"``
- ``reject`` → 触发 ``facade.regenerate_chapter``，``next_action="regenerate"``

get.description:
列出某 session 的 run 目录：manifest + 文件树。

会话不存在 → 404；会话存在但尚无 run 目录（还没跑过任何被追踪的
步骤）→ exists=False + 空清单，前端渲染空态。
鉴权：与其它 session 路由一致，校验 ownership（匿名会话仅 DEBUG 放行）。
返回 trace.jsonl 的尾部事件流（默认最近 50 条）。

BalanceResponse.title: BalanceResponse
BalanceResponse.description:
POST /sessions/{id}/balance 返回体。

修复漂移 1：统一字段名为 ``balanced`` / ``unbalanced`` / ``n_periods``
/ ``attrition_rate``。后端 BalanceStep 的 step report 只含
``balanced`` / ``n_periods`` / ``attrition_rate``，``unbalanced`` 在
router 层补算（balanced 减去总 panel 数，或在 facade 层补）。

ChapterResponse.title: ChapterResponse
ChapterResponse.description:
论文章节（generate_title / generate_chapter 写入）。

status 枚举：``generated`` | ``approved`` | ``edited`` | ``rolled_back``。
前端可在本地临时态再加 ``streaming`` / ``done``。

ChapterSpec.title: ChapterSpec
ChapterSpec.description: 章节定义（用户选择要生成哪一章）。

DatasetMetaResponse.title: DatasetMetaResponse
DatasetMetaResponse.description: 单个数据集的元信息（upload 返回 / state.uploaded_datasets[]）。

DirectionRequest.title: DirectionRequest
DirectionRequest.description:
POST /sessions/{id}/direction 请求体。

方法列（time_col / instrument / running 等）必须能进门。
extra=allow：未列名的别名键也保留，交给 set_direction 投影。

EdaResponse.title: EdaResponse
EdaResponse.description:
POST /sessions/{id}/eda 返回体。

EDA 动作返回的 shape 因 action 而异（describe / corr / missing /
placeholder），统一用 ``Any`` 承载具体字段，但保留 ``action`` 标识。
describe / corr / missing 的结构由各 action 的实现决定，前端按
``action`` 分支渲染。

EditChapterRequest.title: EditChapterRequest
EditChapterRequest.description:
POST /sessions/{id}/edit-chapter 请求体。

一条路由两种意图（T-08c / Copaper 写后 refine）：
- ``instruction``：把用户指令应用到当前章（走 generate_chapter）
- ``content``：把用户编辑后的 markdown 落盘（不调 LLM）

EditChapterResponse.title: EditChapterResponse
EditChapterResponse.description:
POST /sessions/{id}/edit-chapter 返回体。

与 regenerate 同形：改过的章 + 全表。instruction 走 generate_chapter
时附带评审字段；content 落盘不审，评审字段为空。

JourneyResponse.title: JourneyResponse
JourneyResponse.description:
GET /sessions/{id}/journey 返回体：8 阶段旅程整体进度。

阶段（0-index）：
0 选题 1 文献 2 数据清洗 3 识别策略 4 估计建模 5 稳健性审计 6 写作评审 7 降AIGC导出
可介入：{0, 2, 3, 5, 6}

JourneyStageItem.title: JourneyStageItem
JourneyStageItem.description: 8 阶段研究旅程的单个阶段状态。

OutlineChapterResponse.title: OutlineChapterResponse
OutlineChapterResponse.description:
大纲章节项（outline 列表元素，DirectionResponse / ResumeResponse 引用）。

放在共享区，避免 DirectionResponse 引用时出现前向引用。

PaperAnalysisEvidenceResponse.title: PaperAnalysisEvidenceResponse
PaperAnalysisEvidenceResponse.description: Exact executed-estimate facts backing the main claim.

PaperDraftResponse.title: PaperDraftResponse
PaperDraftResponse.description: One-shot paper result or a structured formal-draft refusal.

PaperReferenceResponse.title: PaperReferenceResponse
PaperReferenceResponse.description: APA reference produced by the existing generate_references node.

PaperSourceEvidenceResponse.title: PaperSourceEvidenceResponse
PaperSourceEvidenceResponse.description: Resolver-verified source metadata; no fabricated full-text excerpt.

ProgressChapterSummary.title: ProgressChapterSummary
ProgressChapterSummary.description: progress 端点返回的章节概要。

ReviewInfoResponse.title: ReviewInfoResponse
ReviewInfoResponse.description: GET /sessions/{id}/review 返回体：当前章评审信息。

ReviewRubricResponse.title: ReviewRubricResponse
ReviewRubricResponse.description: 经济学论文评审 5 维 rubric 分项（每维度 0-1，缺失为 None）。

SessionInfoResponse.title: SessionInfoResponse
SessionInfoResponse.description: GET /sessions/{id} 返回体：会话存在性 + 刷新后要保住的读数。
